blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Image translation is a fundamental capability of multimodal models for multilingual applications, requiring visual understanding and meaning preservation across languages.
However, existing benchmarks have limited language coverage and often lack explicit image-specific evaluation criteria, making it difficult to comprehensively assess this capability.
To systematically evaluate this capability, we introduce VISTA-Bench, covering 22 languages and 10 domains, and develop an image-specific rubric evaluation protocol.
The benchmark combines sampling for language and scenario coverage with model-assisted, human-verified annotations that group related text into coherent semantic units and provide multilingual reference translations.
The rubrics specify essential content, semantic relations, and acceptable translation variants, yielding separate output-based scores for translation quality and the preservation of visual and knowledge-dependent information.
We conduct extensive evaluations of 16 mainstream models, including 12 multimodal models and four text-input models, and provide systematic analyses across languages, domains, and evaluation dimensions.
The code and data will be available at https://github.com/lvbotenbest/VISTA-BENCH .
blocks.zh:
图像翻译是多种语言应用的多式联运模型的基本能力,需要视觉理解,意味着跨语言的保存.
然而,现有基准的语言覆盖面有限,往往缺乏针对具体形象的明确评价标准,因此难以全面评估这种能力。
为了系统地评价这种能力,我们引进了涵盖22种语言和10个领域的VISTA-Bench,并制定了针对图像的标点评价协议。
基准将语言和情景覆盖的抽样与模型辅助、经人验证的说明结合起来,将相关文本分为连贯的语义单元,并提供多种语文的参考翻译。
标题中具体规定了基本内容,语义关系,以及可接受的翻译变体,为翻译质量和保存视觉和知识依赖信息分别得出基于输出的分数.
我们广泛评价16个主流模式,包括12个多式联运模式和4个文本输入模式,并提供跨语言、领域和评价层面的系统分析。
该编码和数据可在https://github.com/lvbotenbest/VISTA-BENCH上查阅。 。 。 。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Image translation requires coordinating visual information acquisition, semantic interpretation, and target-language generation to preserve meaning across languages ( Zhu et al., 2023 ; Lv et al., 2024 ) .
For multimodal large language models, this goes beyond recognizing isolated text: models must interpret relationships among text regions and use visual context to resolve ambiguity where necessary ( Qian et al., 2024 ) .
We study image-in, translated-text-out evaluation; text localization, layout reconstruction, background preservation, and translated-image quality are outside its scope.
A suitable benchmark must therefore combine diverse language and scene coverage with evaluation that accommodates valid translation variation while detecting omissions or mistranslations of essential information and semantic relationships.
blocks.zh:
图像翻译需要协调视觉信息的获取,语义翻译,以及目标语言生成,以保存跨语言的含义(Zhu等人,2023年;Lv等人,2024年).
对于多式联运大型语言模型,这不仅仅是承认孤立的文本:模型必须解释文本区域之间的关系,并在必要时利用视觉上下文解决模糊性(Qian等人,2024年)。
我们研究图像输入、翻译文本输出评价;文本本地化、布局重建、背景保存和翻译图像质量不在它的范围内。
因此,一个适当的基准必须把不同的语言和场景覆盖与评价结合起来,既顾及有效的翻译变化,又发现基本信息和语义关系的遗漏或错误翻译。

blocks.en:
Existing benchmarks have advanced visually situated translation, multilingual coverage, and position-aware evaluation ( Salesky et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Zhuang et al., 2025 ) .
These benchmarks employ automatic translation metrics such as BLEU ( Papineni et al., 2002 ) , chrF ( Popović, 2015 ) , and COMET ( Rei et al., 2020 ) .
Recent work also incorporates multimodal model-based judging ( Li et al., 2026 ) .
Nevertheless, source- and target-language coverage remains uneven, and individual benchmarks emphasize different subsets of real-world scenarios.
On the evaluation side, aggregate similarity scores and general quality judgments do not necessarily reveal whether a translation satisfies the specific requirements of an image.
Visual-dependence annotations and localization metrics provide useful complementary information, but they serve different purposes from explicitly specifying which meanings, relations, and acceptable interpretations should be preserved.
blocks.zh:
现有基准已推进了视距翻译、多语种覆盖和地位意识评价(Salesky等人,2024年;Li等人,2025年;Zhuang等人,2025年)。
这些基准采用诸如BLEU(Papineni等人,2002年)和chrF等自动翻译指标。 (Popović, 2015), and Comet (Rei等人, 2020).
最近的工作还包括基于多式联运模式的判断(Li等人,2026年)。
然而,来源和目标语言的覆盖范围仍然不均衡,个别基准强调现实世界情景的不同子集。
在评价方面,总的相似性分数和一般质量判断并不一定表明翻译是否符合图像的具体要求。
视觉依赖说明和本地化衡量标准提供了有用的补充信息,但其目的不同,没有明确规定应当保留哪些含义、关系和可接受的解释。

blocks.en:
To address these needs, we introduce VISTA-Bench, comprising 2,228 images across 22 languages, 10 major domains, and 100+ fine-grained scenarios.
Its construction jointly considers source-language and scenario coverage, using sampling across language–scenario groups to obtain a compact evaluation set.
Model-assisted annotation and human verification establish the source text, semantic blocks, and multilingual reference translations (Appendix ).
In particular, annotators merge fragments that jointly express a semantic unit while retaining the separation of unrelated content.
This process organizes the benchmark around meaningful source content rather than treating individual text detections as independent translation units.
blocks.zh:
为解决这些需求,我们引入了VISTA-Bench, 包括22种语言的2,228幅图像,10个主要领域,以及100+精细描述的情景.
它的构建共同考虑了源语言和情景的涵盖范围,利用跨语种的抽样来获得一套紧凑的评价。
模型辅助注释和人文验证建立了源文本,语义块,以及多语种参考翻译(附录 ).
特别是,注释器合并了片段,这些片段在保留不相关内容分离的同时,共同表达语义单位.
这个过程将基准组织在有意义的源内容上,而不是将单个文本检测作为独立的翻译单位.

blocks.en:
Prior work explores fine-grained MQM error annotation with LLMs ( Kocmi & Federmann, 2023 ) and case-specific MQM rubrics ( Xu et al., 2026 ) .
Alongside the data, we develop an image-specific rubric evaluation protocol.
Each image receives a separate rubric covering visual understanding, translation quality, and knowledge-dependent interpretation where applicable.
Shared criteria are supplemented with target-language-specific requirements when needed.
The criteria specify required meaning, acceptable expressions, and disallowed errors, allowing legitimate variation while making content-specific constraints explicit.
A judge model assesses the candidate translation against these criteria and provides item-level decisions with supporting evidence.
Fixed rules aggregate the decisions by criterion importance within each dimension, yielding separate V, T, and K scores.
Our contribution thus combines coverage-oriented benchmark construction with an evaluation design that connects translation scores to identifiable requirements in individual images.
blocks.zh:
之前的工作探索了精细的MQM差错注释与LLMs(Kocmi & Federmann,2023年)和案例特异性的MQM rubics(Xu等人,2026年).
除了数据外,我们还制定了图像专用评价协议。
每个图像都有一个单独的标题,酌情包括视觉理解、翻译质量和知识依赖口译。
必要时,以针对具体语言的要求补充共同标准。
标准具体规定了要求的含义、可接受的表达方式和不允许的误差,允许合法的更改,同时明确具体内容的限制。
一个法官模型根据这些标准评估候选人翻译,并提供有证据的项目级决定。
固定规则按每个层面的标准重要性汇总决定,得出单独的V、T和K分数。
因此,我们的贡献是将面向覆盖的基准构建与评价设计结合起来,将翻译分数与单个图像中可识别的要求联系起来。

blocks.en:
The remainder of this paper is organized as follows.
After reviewing related work, we describe the construction of VISTA-Bench and its image-specific rubric evaluation protocol.
We then benchmark 16 mainstream models, comprising 12 multimodal models and four text-input models, across 22 languages and 10 domains.
We analyze translation quality alongside visual understanding and knowledge use, examine variation across languages and domains, and assess dataset-size sensitivity and agreement between automatic judges and human annotators.
blocks.zh:
本文件的其余部分编排如下。
在审查了相关工作之后,我们描述了VISTA-Bench的构建及其图像专用标题评价协议.
然后,我们将16个主流模式作为基准,包括12个多式联运模式和4个文本输入模式,涉及22种语言和10个领域。
我们分析翻译质量与视觉理解和知识使用,审查不同语言和领域之间的差异,评估数据集大小的敏感性以及自动法官和人文注释员之间的协议。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Text-Image Machine Translation
blocks.zh: 2.1 文本图像机翻译

blocks.en:
Text-image machine translation (TIMT) translates source-language text embedded in images into a target language ( Lan et al., 2023 ) .
Existing approaches address both cross-modal alignment and contextual interpretation: PEIT uses pretrained models to bridge the vision–text modality gap in end-to-end translation ( Zhu et al., 2023 ) , while AnyTrans incorporates textual and visual context when translating fragmented text ( Qian et al., 2024 ) .
These complementary directions connect text perception with the preservation of meaning and relationships among text regions.
blocks.zh:
文本图像机翻译(TIMT)将嵌入图像的源语言文本翻译为目标语言(Lan等人,2023年).
现有办法既涉及跨模式协调,也涉及背景解释: PEIT使用经过预先训练的模型来弥补端到端翻译(Zhu等人,2023年)中的视觉-文本模式差距,而AnyTrans则在翻译零散文本时包含文字和视觉上下文(Qian等人,2024年).
这些相辅相成的方向将文本概念与保留文本区域的意义和关系联系起来。

blocks.en: 2.2 Multilingual Image Translation Benchmarks
blocks.zh: 2.2 多语言图像翻译基准

blocks.en:
Among existing multilingual image translation benchmarks ( Salesky et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Tian et al., 2025a ; Li et al., 2026 ) , Vistra and PRIM both use only English source images,
with translations into four and five target languages, respectively.
Vistra focuses on visual context in natural images, whereas PRIM primarily covers images containing a single line of text ( Salesky et al., 2024 ; Tian et al., 2025a ) .
MIT-10M contains source images in eight languages, mainly drawn from web pages and product displays ( Li et al., 2025 ) .
MMTIT-Bench includes images in fourteen source languages other than English and Chinese,
but provides translations only into Chinese and English, covering documents, web pages, and natural scenes ( Li et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
在现有的多语种图像翻译基准中(Salesky等人,2024年;Li等人,2025年;Tian等人,2025年a;Li等人,2026年),Vistra和PRIM都只使用英语源图像,
分别译成四种和五种目标语文。
Vistra侧重于自然图像中的视觉背景,而PRIM主要涵盖包含单行文字的图像(Salesky等人,2024年;Tian等人,2025年a ).
MIT-10M包含8种语言的源图像,主要来自网页和产品显示(Li等人,2025年).
MMTIT-Bench包括除英文和中文以外的14种源语言的图像,
但仅提供中英文译本,涵盖文件,网页,自然场景(Li等人,2026年).

blocks.en:
Across these benchmarks, source–target coverage and scenario emphasis remain uneven.
Evaluation includes BLEU, chrF, and COMET ( Salesky et al., 2024 ) , as well as multimodal judging with shared quality dimensions ( Li et al., 2026 ) .
In text translation, GEMBA-MQM identifies fine-grained error spans ( Kocmi & Federmann, 2023 ) , while Rubric-as-Experts develops case-specific MQM rubrics ( Xu et al., 2026 ) .
Building on these lines of work, VISTA-Bench combines multilingual, multi-scenario coverage with image-specific rubrics that specify required meanings, semantic relations, and acceptable translation variants.
blocks.zh:
在这些基准中,源目标覆盖面和情景重点仍然不均衡。
评价包括BLEU、chrF和COMET(Salesky等人,2024年),以及具有共同质量维度的多式联运(Li等人,2026年)。
在文本翻译中,GEMBA-MQM识别出细纹误差跨度(Kocmi & Federmann, 2023年),而Rubric-as-Experts开发出针对具体案例的MQM rubrics(Xu等人, 2026年).
在这些工作线的基础上,VISTA-Bench将多语种,多情景的覆盖与具体图像的标点结合起来,明确了所需含义,语义关系,以及可接受的翻译变体.

blocks.en: 3.1 Language and Scenario Coverage
blocks.zh: 3.1 语言和情景

blocks.en:
Images from existing collections, local data, and web retrieval undergo source-specific automatic filtering, exact deduplication, and sensitive-information handling (Figure , stage 1).
We then assign language labels and classify images using a two-level taxonomy of major domains and fine-grained usage scenarios, producing a candidate pool of 10,920 images.
For example, printed menus are grouped under dining, road signs under transportation, and textbook content under publications.

然后,我们使用主要域的两级分类法和精细的使用情况方案来分配语言标签和图像分类,生成10 920个图像候选集合。
例如,印刷菜单在餐饮、运输中的路标和出版物中分类。

blocks.en: 3.2 Human Semantic-Block Merging
blocks.zh: 3.2 人类语义学-Block合并

blocks.en:
Accurate image translation relies on understanding how text regions jointly convey meaning, rather than interpreting each fragment in isolation.
We use gpt5.6 sol for OCR and layout-aware semantic grouping (Figure , stage 2).
Annotators correct text, omissions, reading order, and block boundaries against the images, merging fragments that express a shared meaning while keeping unrelated content separate. “Any revision” denotes the proportion of images with at least one text or structural change, counting each image only once.
Across the ten languages in Figure , the mean per-language rate of text or structural revision is 42.7%.
Rates are computed on images with comparable machine and human bounding boxes, excluding text-only annotations.
Structural revisions denote unmatched blocks under one-to-one matching at IoU ≥ 0.5 \geq 0.5 , excluding coordinate-only edits to matched blocks. Figure 2: Human revision rates for ten selected widely used languages.

blocks.en: 3.3 Reference and Rubric Annotation
blocks.zh: 3.3 参考和Rubric说明

blocks.en:
We use gpt5.6 sol to draft both reference translations and rubrics, with human verification at each stage (Figure , stage 3).
Translations into the target languages are drafted from the verified source text, with web search to resolve uncertain names and specialized terms.
Human annotators check and revise these drafts against the images.
The verified source blocks and references then guide rubric drafting, followed by human review and refinement.
Appendix provides a complete rubric example, explains its use, and documents the drafting and judge prompt templates.

blocks.en:
To account for lexical ambiguity and variation in valid translations, we construct a separate rubric for each image to complement its verified reference translations.
Each rubric defines three output-based diagnostics: V V checks preservation of text coverage, grouping, and visual associations; T T checks semantic fidelity and natural target-language expression; and K K checks knowledge-dependent interpretations.
Knowledge criteria apply only where needed and do not reward additional facts.
These scores describe which requirements the translation satisfies, not whether the model actually relied on a particular visual cue or knowledge source.
blocks.zh:
为了说明在有效翻译方面的词汇模糊和变化,我们为每个图像设计一个单独的标题,以补充经核实的参考翻译。
每个标题定义三个基于输出的诊断: V V 检查文本覆盖、分组和视觉协会的保存情况; T T 检查语义忠诚度和自然目标语言表达方式; K 检查知识依赖性解释.
知识标准只在需要时适用,不奖励其他事实。
这些分数描述了翻译满足哪些要求,而不是模型是否实际依赖于特定的视觉提示或知识源.

3.4 Evaluation Protocol

blocks.en: 4.1 Models

blocks.en:
We report results for 16 models: 12 multimodal models and four text-input baselines.
The multimodal group includes gpt-6-astra, doubao-seed-2-1-pro-260915, gemini-3.8-flash, qwen3.8-max-0902, muse-spark-1.3, claude-sonnet-5, qwen3.8-27b-fp8, deepseek-flash, gpt-5.6-luna, glm-5.3-flash, glm-4.1v-9b, and gemma-4-e4b ( Gemma Team, 2026 ) .
These models receive the original image and a target-language instruction, following Section .

我们报告16种模式的结果:12种多式联运模式和4种文本投入基线。
多式联运组包括gpt-6-astra,doubao-种子-2-1-pro-260915,gemini-3.8-flash,qwen3.8-max-0902,muse-spark-1.3,claude-sonnet-5,qwen3.8-27b-fp8, deepseek-flash,gpt-5.6-luna,glm-5.3-flash,glm-4.1v-9b,以及gemma-4-e4b. (Gemma Team,2026年).

The four text-input baselines reported in Table are aya-23-8B-text ( Aryabumi et al., 2024 ) , gemma-3-4b-it-text ( Gemma Team, 2025 ) , HY-MT2-30B-A3B-text ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) , and Qwen3-4B-text ( Qwen Team, 2025 ) .
The -text suffix identifies text-input runs; no results for other text-input configurations are claimed here.
For the reported text-input results, source text is organized using human-annotated layouts, and the models do not receive the original image.

表中报告的4个文本输入基线分别是:aya-23-8B文本(Aryabumi等人,2024年),gemma-3-4b-it文本(Gemma Team,2025年),HY-MT2-30B-A3B文本(郑等人,2026年),以及Quen3-4B文本(Quen Team,2025年).

We report T, V, and K independently on a 0–100 scale, with T as the primary measure and V and K as complementary diagnostics.
For image-input models, retained criterion scores are importance-weighted within each dimension and direction, and global scores average directions equally. Domain T applies the same procedure within each domain over common valid directions.

The Overall column in Table denotes global T, not a composite of the three dimensions.

blocks.zh: 4.3 域级业绩

blocks.en:
Among the image-input models, GPT-6 Astra achieves the highest global T (77.63) and ranks first in eight of the ten domains.
The exceptions are Healthcare, led by Gemini 3.8 Flash (79.52), and Finance, led by Doubao Seed 2.1 Pro (80.20).
Within the open-weight image-input group, Qwen3.8 27B has the highest global T (61.11), while DeepSeek Flash leads in Dining, Tourism, Healthcare, Safety, and Finance.
These changes in ranking show why domain-level scores complement the global average.
Appendix reports domain T by translation target language, averaging over source languages.

在图像输入模型中,GPT-6 Astra实现了全球T(77.63)最高,在十个域中排名第一.
例外是双子座3.8 Flash(79.52)领导的医疗保健和Doubao种子2.1 Pro(80.20)领导的Finance。
在开放量图像输入组内,Qune3.8 27B拥有全球最高的T(61.11),而DeepSeek Flash则领先于迪宁,旅游,保健,安全,金融.
排名的这些变化表明域级分数为何补充全球平均值.
附录报告领域 T通过翻译目标语言,平均超过源语言.

blocks.en:
With human-organized source text, HY-MT2 30B-A3B achieves a global T of 72.82, compared with 77.63 for GPT-6 Astra.
It exceeds the best image-input scores in Products (78.02 vs. 76.11) and Healthcare (81.67 vs. 79.52), but trails in Finance (64.56 vs. 80.20).
The supplied semantic blocks let the text-input model bypass image recognition and layout recovery, whereas image-input models must recover both the text and its organization from pixels.
This contrast highlights text grouping and reading order as additional requirements of image translation.
blocks.zh:
有了人类组织的源文本,HY-MT2 30B-A3B实现全球T72.82,而GPT-6 Astra则达到了77.63.
它超过了产品(78.02 vs 76.11)和保健(81.67 vs 79.52)中的最佳图像输入分数,但是在财务(64.56 vs 80.20)中却有足迹.
所提供的语义块让文本输入模型绕过图像识别和布局恢复,而图像输入模型则必须从像素中恢复文本及其组织.

blocks.en:
The profiles expose both common bottlenecks and model-specific strengths.
Burmese is the lowest-scoring source language for all six models, ranging from 22.90 for GLM-5.3 Flash to 51.22 for GPT-6 Astra.
Dutch is strongest for Gemini 3.8 Flash, Claude Sonnet 5, Qwen3.8 27B, and GLM-5.3 Flash, whereas Czech is strongest for GPT-6 Astra and DeepSeek Flash.
GPT-6 Astra obtains the highest score among these models on 19 of the 22 languages.
The three China-developed models shown all exceed their own language averages on Chinese: Qwen3.8 27B scores 64.79 versus 60.96, DeepSeek Flash 61.78 versus 61.06, and GLM-5.3 Flash 58.82 versus 55.21.
By contrast, GPT-6 Astra, Gemini 3.8 Flash, and Claude Sonnet 5 score 2.20–3.95 points below their respective averages on Chinese.
The shared difficulty on Burmese and differing language strengths show the value of broad source-language coverage: it exposes both common weaknesses and capabilities concentrated in particular languages.
These profiles identify where multilingual image translation needs further improvement.
Complete source-to-target T matrices for all 12 models are provided in Appendix .

For Qwen3.6 and Qwen3.8 Max, respectively, Pearson correlations with Human are 0.9992 and 0.9976, and Lin’s concordance correlation coefficients are 0.9883 and 0.9869.
The corresponding MAEs are 1.75 and 1.82 points.
All eight automatic scores are higher than their human references, indicating a small but consistent positive offset rather than exact score equivalence.
Switching between the two automatic judges changes model scores by 1.25 points on average and at most 2.34 points, without changing the ranking.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We introduced VISTA-Bench, comprising 2,228 images across 22 languages and 10 domains, with coverage-oriented sampling, human-verified semantic blocks, and multilingual references.
Our image-specific rubrics specify required meanings, semantic relations, and acceptable variants, yielding separate scores for translation quality, visual understanding, and knowledge use.
We evaluated 12 multimodal models and four text-input baselines.
The image-input results expose language and domain disparities and show that higher translation scores generally accompany stronger visual and knowledge scores.
The compact subset preserves the tested models’ ranking while reducing evaluation workload.
Rubric-guided judges closely match human model-level assessments, with Qwen3.6 achieving agreement comparable to Qwen3.8 Max.
VISTA-Bench thus combines broad coverage with content-specific evaluation to support model comparison and targeted diagnosis.

紧凑子集保留了被测试模型的排名,同时减少了评价工作量。
Rubric-guided judges紧密匹配人类模型级评估,Quen3.6达成与Quen3.8 Max相当的协议.
因此,VISTA-Bench将广泛的覆盖范围与针对具体内容的评价结合起来,以支持模型比较和有针对性的诊断。

Across the 12 models within each source language, Pearson correlations range from 0.9277 to 0.9917 for T–V and from 0.8635 to 0.9932 for T–K, showing strong alignment.
GPT-6 Astra leads T on 16 of the 22 source languages, V on 15, and K on six.
Within GPT-6 Astra, correlations across the 22 source-language means are 0.6820 for T–V and 0.7274 for T–K, lower than the cross-model correlations in Section .

在每种源语言的12种模型中,皮尔逊的亲和度在T-V的0.9277至0.9917之间,在T-K的0.8635至0.9932之间,显示出强烈的吻合性.
GPT-6 Astra在22种源语言中的16种,V在15种,K在6种.

blocks.en:
Burmese has the lowest T for 11 of the 12 models, the lowest K for 11, and the lowest V for ten.
For GPT-6 Astra, its Burmese scores are 51.22 in T, 51.29 in K, and 66.22 in V, compared with 78.92, 88.64, and 91.33 on English.
The lower scores identify Burmese as a shared difficulty under the three rubric diagnostics; they do not isolate the source of the errors or exclude annotation and judge limitations.
blocks.zh:
缅甸在12种模式中,有11种为最低T,11种为最低K,10种为最低V.
对于GPT-6 Astra来说,其缅甸的得分是T的51.22分,K的51.29分,V的66.22分,而英语的78.92分,88.64分和91.33分.
较低的分数将缅甸确定为三大诊断下的一个共同困难;它们并不孤立错误的来源,也不排除注释和判断限制。
